full_details: The almanac said Michaelmas term begins. It runs to the twenty-eighth of November. At the Theatre the bills were the comedy, and The Grecian Comedy at the Rose. By one the galleries were black: Gray's Inn, Lincoln's Inn, the Temples. They shouted Remuneration at Kemp. They had come for the king. Some saw it on Tuesday. The rest had heard. Margery had told every third man Thursday next, and they had written it down. A gentleman of Gray's Inn gave you the opening of Gaunt's England and asked if it would be printed. You said it was the company's, and sent him to the book-keeper. Abel looked at him as at a burglar. A gentleman of the Middle Temple had York's warning, and meant to argue a dead man's will at a moot. You were Navarre. The jaw went through the vowels. You did not go to the Rose. At night the jaw was too loud for Verona. You copied an old foul sheet fair on one leaf, no title, no number, no name, and put it back. You wrote tomorrow's look at the tooth into the almanac. You addressed nobody.
one_sentence: Term opened, the galleries were black with gowns for a comedy, you sent the book to Abel, and at night you copied one leaf fair.
title: The gowns came for the king
